status: implementation draft; not built or executed
purpose: Collect paired warm-cache CUDA-event operator measurements for the public GGUF vector route and an explicit conventional vector-kernel baseline using identical weights and activation buffers.

scope.candidate: Existing public vector_product or vector_swiglu dispatch, including any enabled candidate routes.
scope.baseline: Test-only direct kernel launch with two output rows per warp; baseline decoder retains only the existing Q4_K/Q6_K cooperative-decode setting and bypasses other candidate scheduling and decode routes.
scope.correctness_gate: Exact BF16 output comparison before warm-up and timing.
scope.timing: Dedicated stream; 20 alternating warm-up launches per arm; fixed ABBA windows; CUDA events; default 20 blocks and 100 launches per window; raw window values and paired per-block averages emitted as JSONL.
scope.interpretation: Warm-cache operator evidence only; does not establish full-model or end-to-end latency improvement.

inputs.default: Deterministic synthetic GGUF blocks and deterministic BF16 activations quantized with the existing Q8_1 activation quantizer before timing.
inputs.optional_weight_directory: Pinned fixture inputs are required if --weight-dir is supplied. Current fixture rows are tiled cyclically to requested N and labeled pinned_fixture_repeated_257_rows; they are not full actual-shape weight matrices. Missing requested fixtures fail without synthetic fallback.

review_questions: Confirm strict baseline decoder arithmetic and lane-cooperative paths are equivalent to the pre-candidate conventional decoder for the supported Q4_K/Q6_K benchmark shapes.
Confirm the baseline launch geometry is a suitable reference while preserving only the existing cooperative-decode setting, and that candidate dispatch remains through the public API.
Check CUDA template instantiation and parser-mode interactions at build/test time after the active GPU screen has ended.

Interpret any measured win at operator scope only; the nonfused Q4 K5120 profile contribution was previously small relative to the whole workload, while fused Q4 and Q6 routes are included as higher-value targets.

validation.reason: Parent-directed prohibition while screen PID 23976 is active.
